title: 어떤 걸 찾아요? 좋은 카페, 큰 사이즈
objective: By the end, you can change an adjective or noun + 이다 into its -(으)ㄴ form (좋은, 큰, 긴, 매운, 의사인) and use it before a noun to say what kind of thing or person you mean.
summary: Put an adjective or noun + 이다 in front of a noun with -(으)ㄴ to describe it, as in 좋은 카페 or 의사인 친구.

task.title: Make the right form
task.line: Change each adjective or noun into its form before a noun, or check if the form is right.

forms.when: The stem ends in a consonant (좋다, 작다).
forms.means: Describes the noun after it: 좋다 → 좋은, 작다 → 작은.
forms.exampleMeaning: Is there a good café near here?

forms.when: The stem ends in a vowel (크다, 싸다, 친절하다).
forms.means: Add ㄴ under the last syllable: 크다 → 큰, 싸다 → 싼.
forms.exampleMeaning: Do you have a bigger size?

forms.when: The stem ends in ㄹ (길다, 멀다).
forms.means: Take away ㄹ, then add ㄴ: 길다 → 긴, 멀다 → 먼.

forms.when: Most stems ending in ㅂ (맵다, 덥다, 쉽다). Some are regular: 좁다 → 좁은. (넓다 ends in ㄼ, not ㅂ, so it simply takes -은: 넓은.)
forms.means: ㅂ changes to 우, then add ㄴ: 맵다 → 매운, 덥다 → 더운.
forms.example: 저는 매운 음식을 잘 못 먹어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I can't eat spicy food well.

forms.means: Use 인 after any noun to say who or what someone is: 의사 → 의사인.
forms.exampleMeaning: I asked my friend who is a doctor.

watchOut: 맛있은 빵 (X) → 맛있는 빵 (O): Words ending in 있다/없다 (맛있다, 재미없다) take -는, not -은.
힘들은 일 (X) → 힘든 일 (O): With a ㄹ stem, drop ㄹ and add ㄴ.
덥은 날씨 (X) → 더운 날씨 (O): ㅂ becomes 우 + ㄴ. (좁다 → 좁은 does not change.)
학생은 친구 (X) → 학생인 친구 (O): After a noun, use 인. 학생은 is the topic marker, not this form.
exercises: Fill in the blank with the right form of the word in brackets: ① ____ 방을 찾고 있어요. (조용하다) ② ____ 날에는 따뜻한 차를 마셔요. (춥다) ③ 회사에서 ____ 집으로 이사했어요. (가깝다)
Fill in the blank with the right form of the word in brackets: ① 너무 ____ 곳은 가고 싶지 않아요. (멀다) ② 저는 ____ 커피를 안 좋아해요. (달다)
Choose the right word: 어제 (재미있은 / 재미있는) 영화를 봤어요.
Join the two sentences into one: 리나 씨는 간호사예요. + 리나 씨는 병원에서 일해요. → ____ 리나 씨는 병원에서 일해요.
Is the adjective form right? Write O, or write the correct form: ① 길은 줄 ② 깨끗한 화장실 ③ 무거운 가방 ④ 짧는 치마
answers: ① 조용한 ② 추운 ③ 가까운
① 긴 ② O ③ O ④ 짧은
